scope: Theorem C.1 (Signed representative) of the manuscript “Conditional good minimal models for compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Conditional-good-minimal-models-for-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eebddaadef6935c3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 93. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, D) be a projective Q-factorial dlt pair over C, with D = P i Di reduced. Suppose that L = KX + D is nef, L − cD is pseudo-effective for some c > 0, and that L ∼Q G = X i aiDi, ai ∈ Q. If L|D is semiample as a rational line bundle on the reduced scheme D, then L is abundant: κ(X, L) = ν(X, L).
